notes.title: Retiring Zombie Camp
notes.notes:
Hello our players,

We decided to stop selling Zombie Camp in Steam soon due to some internal decisions. This will not affect players who have already purchased it. We really thank you for supporting this little game and thank Valve for providing such a great platform so that we can share our creation to the world.

Thank you again.

Void Dimensions

notes.title: First Winner Appeared!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to tell you that we just had the first winner who managed to beat the boss since our hand-to-hand update!

This guy's ID is deathandlord, who is now ranking 1st with 75,000 score!

Thank you for playing Zombie Camp so hard!

notes.title: "Hand-to-Hand Survival" Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce the great "Hand-to-Hand Survival" update for the coming Halloween holiday. Zombie Camp would be a great addition to any Vive Owner's game set who wants to get into the holiday spirit of "getting some baddies".

The biggest upgrade in this update includes a new fight scenario using punches, planks, and grenades, effectively doubling the size of our game. We provide a Leaderboard to track the best zombie hunters thorough their Steam login, and made several user interface changes that make the gameplay and weapon usage more understandable, such as by showing two visual hands to orient the player when starting the game.

We also provided several sounds to the zombies, bats, and weapons to give the game more polish, and to differentiate in-game event occurrences. We finally reorganized several texts on the title screen and during play that give the player better indication on how to play and how to navigate between scenes.
